assumptions: STFT normalization fitted on training diameter only.
Thickness targets never enter STFT construction or network inputs.
Fixed94-140us ringdown gate and6-20mm candidate echo interval are declared exercise priors, not chosen per target.
Echo/correlation ambiguity and held-out failures are retained.
BSEE Figure12 is recovered above-water structural casing and is NOT added as a training image.
